NOTICE
                                    DATE: 25/08/2026

This is for information to all students seeking admission to the PG Programmes in Assamese
and Botany, as per the Provisional Merit List published by Bhattadev University, Bajali that
the date of admission has been fixed for 27/08/2026. Applicants are requested to carefully
note the following points:
Date of Admission: 27/08/2026
Venue: Seminar Hall, Madhab Choudhury College, Barpeta, Assam
Time: 10.00 am onwards

Applicants are requested to bring all the original documents.

Fee structure:

Assamese: Rs. 20,000.00 (Rupees Twenty Thousand only/year)
Botany: Rs. 45,000.00 (Rupees Forty Five Thousand only/year)

Intake capacity:-
Assamese: 20
Botany: 25
Reservation of the seats will be maintained as per State Govt. rules.
Cashless transection with Debit Card (ATM card)/online transfer system is mandatory.

For more details please contact:
Dr. Eushah Ali (9707497327)
Dr. Arjun Adhikari (7002652558)
Prof. Manjit Pathak (8486804798)




                                                             (Dr. Prakash Sarma)
                                                                    Principal,
                                                             Madhab Choudhury      College,
